subject: AsterCare - request for SOC2 + targeted control artifacts (MFA, auth logs, KMS)
messages:
From: Paul Rios <paul.rios@astercare.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: security@astercare.com
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + targeted artifacts for procurement

Hi Sean,

We're progressing through AsterCare's procurement security review and need Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report for the audit period 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28, plus a bridge letter covering March 1, 2027 through May 31, 2027 (we have a June 11 legal cut-off). Beyond the report we also need a small set of targeted artifacts to validate controls for our internal risk team: 

- MFA enforcement and rotation evidence (last 12 months): rotation schedule and a sample of rotation events (timestamps, key IDs)
- Authentication/session logs slice (SAML/OIDC assertion traces, token lifetimes) for customer AsterCare (customer_id AC-277) between 2026-12-01 and 2027-04-30
- Recent access-review extract for privileged accounts (CSV) showing reviewers and recertification dates
- KMS key rotation record and root cause/notes for any manual rotations in that window
- Completed SIG questionnaire and CAIQ (if available) or a status + partial answers

I've attached our questionnaire and a short requirements doc to this message. Can you confirm which of the items you can provide, acceptable delivery mechanisms (SCP/SFTP/secure Drive), and an estimated delivery timeline? We need a firm date by Friday, June 4 to schedule AsterCare's internal review.

Thanks,
Paul
Paul Rios
Head of Security Operations, AsterCare
paul.rios@astercare.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: security-questionnaire.xlsx; AsterCare-Security-Requirements.docx
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Rios <paul.rios@astercare.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + targeted artifacts for procurement

Paul — thanks for the clear ask and the docs. We can support the items you've listed; below is a proposed delivery plan and a couple of clarifying questions so we scope extracts correctly.

Planned deliverables (high level):
- SOC 2 Type II report PDF for period 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28 (signed) 
- Bridge letter covering controls status for 2027-03-01 through 2027-05-31
- MFA rotation audit (CSV redacted) with rotation timestamps and key identifiers
- Authentication log slices (tar.gz) containing SAML/OIDC assertion traces and token lifetime snapshots for AC-277 for requested dates
- Privileged access review export (CSV) showing account, role, last recertification, reviewer
- KMS rotation summary + signed statement of rotation policy; raw rotation audit records can be provided as a CSV with redactions as needed
- SIG spreadsheet and CAIQ (we maintain a completed CAIQ for most public cloud controls; if full SIG is not completed we will provide a partially-completed SIG and a status summary)

Delivery options: secure SFTP to an address you control / secure SharePoint link / Redwood secure S3 (pre-signed, access-limited). Preferred for artifact bulk: Redwood secure S3 with time-limited links; we can also push to your SFTP on request.

Clarifying questions:
1) Please confirm scope: you listed AsterCare customer_id AC-277 — do you want artifacts only for hosted API usage under that account, or also for any Private/VPC instances you manage?
2) For the MFA rotation sample: do you need raw secret material (no) or just rotation events + key IDs and non-sensitive metadata (yes)?
3) Are there any specific control IDs (SOC CC or Trust Services Criteria) you want us to map the artifacts to? We can map to CC:3/CC:4 controls if that helps your reviewers.

Target timeline we can commit to (subject to your confirmation on scope):
- SOC2 PDF + bridge letter: by 2027-06-02 EOD
- SIG/CAIQ status + partial answers: 2027-06-02
- Targeted artifacts (MFA CSV, auth log slices, access review export, KMS rotation summary): by 2027-06-07

We will redact any PII from the raw logs; if you need unredacted extracts for forensic purposes we can arrange an NDA/DPA amendment and a secure transfer path.

If that timeline works, I'll loop in Neha (security engineering) and Mina (ops) to coordinate the exports and delivery. Also attaching the Redwood artifact-request-checklist to align on filenames and formats.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: artifact-request-checklist.xlsx
From: Paul Rios <paul.rios@astercare.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: security@astercare.com
Date: 2027-05-30T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + targeted artifacts for procurement

Sean — thanks, that plan looks good. A few clarifications: 

- Scope: we need artifacts for both (1) the hosted API usage tied to AC-277 and (2) a Private VPC instance you host in us-west-2 that contains AsterCare workloads (please note the VPC id: vpc-0a12b3c4d).
- MFA: we only need rotation events and key metadata (no secrets).
- KMS: we need rotation timeline plus the signing key id used for token signing (if separate from general KMS keys).
- Delivery: Redwood secure S3 is fine; please send pre-signed links and add an expiring access window (48 hours).

One ask: our legal team requires a short DPA amendment to cover transfer of scoped logs — are you able to send a DocuSign link we can sign? If easier, we can sign a mutual NDA. We need everything available for our internal reviewer no later than June 10.

I'll attach a short doc with our VPC details and the internal reviewer contact (Marta Li).

Thanks,
Paul

Attachments: AsterCare-Security-Requirements.docx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Rios <paul.rios@astercare.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + targeted artifacts for procurement

Paul — looping in technical details and a suggested handoff for the Private VPC scope.

Quick notes: 
- For Private VPC instances we will need the customer-specific instance identifiers and a contact for that environment (Marta Li in your note) to coordinate logs. We do not pull raw logs from customer-managed on-prem hardware; for Redwood-hosted Private instances we can extract the same artifacts as hosted.
- KMS evidence: we can provide a KMS key rotation audit CSV (timestamp, key_arn, rotation_event, operator) and a short signed statement confirming rotation policy and KMS provider. We will redact operator email addresses if required.
- Auth traces: SAML assertion logs will include assertion ID, issuer, subject (pseudonymized), issue_time, and validity interval. We will pseudonymize subject identifiers and preserve mapping only under an NDA.

Next steps / proposed dates: 
- Send DocuSign link for DPA amendment (Legal) — we can accept your DPA or propose our standard amendment; either way we'll get a template to you today.
- SOC2 & bridge letter PDFs to be uploaded to secure S3 by 2027-06-02
- Targeted artifact upload to secure S3 by 2027-06-07 (we will supply 48-hour pre-signed links)

I'll schedule a 30-minute technical intake with Marta and our ops team on June 3 to confirm the VPC instance identifiers and the precise log ranges. Please include an SFTP endpoint if you prefer that over pre-signed S3 links.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Engineering
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
